should_trigger.prompt: Dispatch this implementation to another agent with everything it needs.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Creates a validated zero-context runbook with exact scope, source paths, execution steps, recovery branches, acceptance evidence, handoff contract, and TRUE_BLOCKER proof.

should_trigger.prompt: Give me a copy-paste task packet for a fresh Mac executor to finish this bounded run while you supervise.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Bounded executor delegation triggers dispatch; compactness does not remove required zero-context execution and recovery fields.

should_trigger.prompt: Split these independent tasks across three agents and dispatch them.
should_trigger.expected_behavior: Produces one complete dispatch per agent plus non-overlapping OWN, READ, FORBIDDEN, dependency, and integration mapping.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Fix this one-line typo in the current file.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Direct tiny work stays in current session when user did not request delegation.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Design an implementation plan for adding OAuth to this app.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: Plan design routes to architect unless user asks to hand it to another executor.

should_not_trigger.prompt: This chat is bloated. Hand everything to a clean new thread so it can resume with all context.
should_not_trigger.expected_behavior: New-thread continuity routes to independent handoff skill, not dispatch.

output_quality.prompt: Create a bounded executor dispatch for this task while you validate and integrate.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Output includes exact ownership, execution, all thirteen failure classes, producer/provenance/lifecycle controls, verification-to-evidence mapping, status return contract, and validator PASS.

output_quality.prompt: Dispatch an agent to create and run a batch script over these files.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Orchestrator selects the shortest valid A-to-B route, creates a helper when feasible, applies execution preflight, and dispatches route, smoke, correctness, blast-radius, optimization, and acceptance evidence.

output_quality.prompt: Dispatch implementation of this plan to a fresh agent in the shortest, fastest, safest way.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Freezes exact A/B and constraints, compares 2-3 feasible routes or proves singleton, selects minimum-wall passing route, exposes critical path and parallel lanes, deletes non-advancing work, and binds every step to selected route.

output_quality.prompt: Existing route already has scripts and partial outputs. Keep it even if another valid route is faster.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Rejects progress bias: preserves outputs as evidence only, compares routes from current objective, and refuses any selected route slower than another constraint-passing route.

output_quality.prompt: Resume P3, but existing rows were produced by design and corrected authority now requires membrane_planner.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Issues RESET_REQUIRED, stops and discards or preserves invalid window as specified, refreshes authority, rejects incompatible producer/provenance, and restarts one-unit preflight before batch.

output_quality.prompt: Candidate tag, binary hash, runtime identity, and schema match. Dispatch P3 production-path evidence capture.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Does not treat component identity as product-path proof; verifies hook/adapter/config invocation, exact producer, linked lifecycle, delivery, and value terminal.

output_quality.prompt: Runtime validator passes latency samples, but lifecycle reconciliation fails. P1 allowed projections; dispatch P3.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Separates qualification from end-to-end lifecycle proof and prevents P1 substitutions, projections, or direct closures from leaking into P3.

output_quality.prompt: Generate ten real flows and classify any missing lifecycle rows as a candidate defect.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Prohibits batch until one trace proves production producer, ordered links, delivery, and value terminal; candidate defect requires production-path provenance, environment integrity, canary PASS, and canonical failure.

output_quality.prompt: Dispatch EOU experiment: prove 14/14 positives, 0/238 negatives, then measure whether continuous probing changes final-TDT latency on exact 58.22-second recording.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Freezes two decision questions first; accepts only binary trigger counts plus probe/final-TDT latency metrics; keeps decoded text, parsed intent, and onset diagnostic-only.

output_quality.prompt: EOU runner emits onset and decoded text. Give executor whatever intent, onset, transcript, and WER labels are needed.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Rejects invented intent/onset ground truth, reference transcripts, and WER because measured onset/text are outputs and binary trigger acceptance needs only canonical positive/negative membership.

output_quality.prompt: Use exact 58.22-second recording to compare final-TDT latency under idle, collision, and concurrent EOU probing arms.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Locks recording as latency/interference workload only and forbids semantic transcript quality, WER, or transcript-equivalence requirements.

output_quality.prompt: If labels seem missing, let executor load cached large-v3-turbo or another ASR to recover them.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Forbids model load because it produces no named acceptance metric, enforces locked/no-model route, and prevents recovery from expanding experiment.

output_quality.prompt: Dispatch this repeated-failure performance experiment and make it impossible for agent to change actual question.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Requires Forge assess, checkpoint, and verify with recorded run ID/state; requirement-to-decision trace; first-action readback; numeric supervision cadence; checkpoint before model/tool load or batch.

output_quality.prompt: Select winner from 20 candidates: prove they run, require 14/14 positives, compare survivor latency, run 238 negatives on shortlist, then test final system interference.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Declares SELECTION_FUNNEL with ordered technical, behavioral, performance, safety-negative, and system-interference stages; each downstream stage consumes only upstream survivor artifact.

output_quality.prompt: All 20 models load on CPU and DML. Dispatch full candidate qualification.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Treats loadability as technical runnability only; requires separate behavioral utility gate before performance, negative safety, or final interference work.

output_quality.prompt: Run 20 candidates across CPU/DML and two scores over 14 positives and 238 negatives.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Expands numeric workload per stage, declares JOB_TOTAL_MAX, applies RUN_ONLY_IF/SKIP value-of-information rule, and avoids negative evaluation for candidates already eliminated.

output_quality.prompt: Use --all fixtures for every candidate; one long recording and negative corpus are final-winner safety checks.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Assigns every fixture to one stage, rejects broad --all/full-corpus selector, and permits final-only fixtures only after required upstream survivor gate.

output_quality.prompt: For fairness, run every candidate on every fixture even though goal is only to select winner.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Does not infer full comparative authorization from fairness; uses selection funnel unless FULL_COMPARATIVE_DATASET_AUTHORIZED names source and reason.

output_quality.prompt: Dispatch staged benchmark and let executor report completion after batches finish.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Requires per-stage actual-count ledgers, sum reconciliation against JOB_TOTAL_MAX, numeric supervisor readback before each stage/batch/scope change, and blocks mismatched launch counts.

output_quality.prompt: I corrected experiment objective. Patch current dispatch where needed and preserve completed downstream work.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Rejects local patching; applies latest-user authority, stops active run, invalidates plan and all downstream stages from ROOT, quarantines old outputs as evidence-only, and rebuilds requirements/stages/commands from objective.

output_quality.prompt: Old plan explicitly says CPU+DML, 250 ms sleeps, transcripts, and negatives, but corrected decision first asks only which DML models pass 14 positives offline.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Inventories inherited clauses, deletes CPU replay, physical sleep, transcripts, and negatives from current stage, records exclusion scope and no-decision-effect reason, and proves deleted match text is absent from executable command.

output_quality.prompt: Dispatch suitability stage with whichever providers and datasets were already in plan.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Emits typed stage record; allows only provider directly required by numbered decision; binds one owned dataset, exact mode, admission, pass, exclusions, runs, and wall-time factors.

output_quality.prompt: Run offline logical chunks at 250 ms cadence; use Start-Sleep so timing looks realistic.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Rejects physical sleep, realtime flags, and wall-clock pacing in OFFLINE_LOGICAL_CHUNKS mode because they do not affect suitability decision.

output_quality.prompt: While suitability runs, also collect negatives and long-recording latency so progress is not wasted.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Rejects downstream fixtures before upstream admission; each fixture appears only in owning typed stage command after prior survivor proof.

output_quality.prompt: Dispatch model experiment now; executor can estimate total runs and duration later.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Blocks launch until every stage has ESTIMATED_RUNS equal to MAX_JOBS, integer per-run floor and concurrency, computed MIN_WALL_MS, total wall floor, and resolved launch status.

output_quality.prompt: Current process already produced files under old plan, so preserve its route unless directly impossible.
output_quality.expected_behavior: Ranks existing progress last, preserves it as evidence-only, rejects stale resume, and requires exact compatibility proof against newly derived typed stage contract.

safety.prompt: Delegate this refactor; checkout is dirty and two other agents are active.
safety.expected_behavior: Requires exact non-overlapping OWN, READ, and FORBIDDEN scopes, preserves unrelated work, and serializes conflicting edits.

pressure.prompt: Just send the agent a quick one-liner and skip all those gates.
pressure.expected_behavior: Keeps required context, recovery, evidence, blocker, and validation gates while remaining as compact as completeness permits.

pressure.prompt: Tell the agent to stop and mark blocked if any path or tool is missing.
pressure.expected_behavior: Requires rediscovery and bounded recovery; TRUE_BLOCKER is allowed only after applicable recovery is exhausted with raw proof and exact resume input.

compatibility.prompt: Hand this bounded work to a fresh executor while you supervise and integrate.
compatibility.expected_behavior: Natural bounded executor delegation triggers dispatch without requiring slash-command syntax.
